clone.rationale: 方案判断：可参考词汇匹配和次数约束结合与填满棋盘形成完整目标的机制组合，使用自有实现和获授权的美术；词库、字母计数与关卡解校验是原型验证重点，不代表可直接搬用代码或素材。
suggestions: 自有原型建议，需验证：题材换成「中药配伍」或「菜谱配比」：用有限次数把食材配成完整方子，保留资源约束但换掉英文词汇门槛
自有原型建议，需验证：把「次数数字」改成「字母耐久」，用完即碎，视觉上更有消耗感
自有原型建议，需验证：做中文版本时必须换判题逻辑（无空格分词），可直接用成语/词语库替代单词库，避开与英文产品的正面竞争
risks: 来源覆盖有限，版本关系与细节需在原型前继续核对。
不得直接使用原作素材、品牌或代码，授权情况需确认。

media.description:
Word Tiles is a relaxing word game designed for everyone!

Connect the letter tiles, make words, and fill all the empty spaces on the board! It's a fun twist on the classic crossword puzzle. Track the small numbers on each tile, the numbers show how many times you have to use that letter.

The game is easy to learn and fun to play but also hard to master. There is no timer and no pressure. You can play at your own pace and enjoy every level.

Play hundreds of levels that get harder as you go, with calm and beautiful backgrounds to relax with. It is a great way to pass the time, keep your mind sharp, and have fun. Word Tiles is made for all ages, from young players to seniors.

Download Word Tiles now and start making words! Can you find all of them?
